self-host:vulnerability-cyber-arup-com.summary: Arup takes vulnerability reports by email on the internet-facing systems and services it owns or operates. There's no bug bounty and reports aren't paid. A report needs a reproducible proof of concept, an explanation of the risk and impact, and evidence the issue is in scope, and scanner output on its own isn't accepted. Arup aims to acknowledge within five business days and update within 20, and doesn't intend to take action against researchers who act in good faith and follow the statement.
